results.title: NYC sanitation workers fed up with being pricked by weight-loss drug needles
results.description: A sanitation worker holds a bag of weight loss auto-injector pens, which aren't supposed to be tossed in regular trash. At least 49 sanitation workers have been stuck by needles so far this year. [ more › ]

results.title: Echocardiogram - Harvard Health
results.description: What is the test? An echocardiogram is an ultrasound of the heart. An echocardiogram enables a doctor to examine your heart valves, determine the size of your heart, and assess how well it is functioning.
